title: auth/trusted_issuer_store: verify_and_extract_cn never returns Err
description: crates/auth/src/trusted_issuer_store.rs — verify_and_extract_cn() signature is Result<Option<String>, String> but the function never returns Err(_); all failure paths return Ok(None). This is a lie in the type signature: callers who pattern-match on Err will write dead code, and callers who use ? will not propagate errors. The correct signature is Option<String>. If Err is intentionally reserved for future use, a comment to that effect should be present.
